h1: Uganda tourist visa from the UK
intro: Planning a holiday or a visit to family or friends in Uganda? This page explains the Uganda tourist visa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and enough money for your stay

sections.heading: Do you need a Uganda tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Uganda, applied for online as an eVisa before travelling.

sections.heading: What a Uganda tourist visa covers
sections.text: A Uganda tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Uganda. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Uganda business visa](/uganda-business-visa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually apply the same way. The East Africa Tourist Visa, covering Uganda, Rwanda and Kenya, is also an option.

sections.heading: Uganda tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Uganda tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Uganda.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Uganda tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Uganda tourist visa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Uganda on a Uganda tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does a Uganda tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
